claims: Rory McIlroy is still married to Erica Stoll.
Rory McIlroy filed for divorce in May 2024.
Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll announced one month later that they had reconciled and decided to call off the divorce, choosing to continue their marriage and "move forward as a family".
In June 2024, it was reported that a motion was filed to voluntarily dismiss the divorce petition.
As of April 2026, Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll are still together.
Erica Stoll has been seen supporting Rory McIlroy at tournaments, including the Masters.
Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll married in 2017.
Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll have a daughter named Poppy, born in 2020.
